source_tension: Released temporal Wout uses one channel direction plus a frame mask; mask and temporal frequency projection do not commute, so content compensation can leak into motion
mechanism: Project Q(X) into temporal DC/AC and use one rank-1 output direction per component
baseline_delta: Equal learned parameters to shared rank-2; parameter-free projections
supporting_evidence: Exact released path decomposition exists; Dynamic Degree sensitivity motivates AC-specific diagnosis
closest_prior_work: Unresolved; profiling is mechanism validation, not novelty proof
novelty_risk: Could be interpreted as a simple frequency split unless held-out gains and mask leakage are strong
cheapest_falsification: Paired-input held-out equal-parameter residual fit on four temporal proj blocks
expected_observation: DC/AC rank1x2 materially beats shared rank2 and preserves paired trajectory behavior
estimated_cost: One smoke plus two full GPU2 profiles
decision_reason: Mask leakage is negligible and fixed 1+1 rank allocation loses badly to shared rank2 on untouched prompt 6
notes: MTD total gain vs shared rank2 -424.39%; baseline -97.03%; no positive blocks

source_tension: Shared additive rank2 generalizes substantially better than rank1 while fixed DC/AC allocation fails; current released Wout has only one output direction
mechanism: Add a rank1 attn_temp.proj Wout branch whose output factor is orthogonal to the released Wout output factor
baseline_delta: One extra rank1 branch relative to the released baseline; equal-parameter rank1 and rank2 controls
supporting_evidence: Orthogonal rank1 local gain is 18.70% MTD and 32.25% baseline, but retains only 77.85% and 76.03% of unconstrained rank1 gain; structured rank2 retains 75.85% and 81.49% of shared rank2 gain
closest_prior_work: Closest prior work unresolved; novelty audit was not promoted because the mechanism gate failed
novelty_risk: Collapses toward ordinary rank expansion and does not protect trajectory AC
cheapest_falsification: Held-out equal-parameter unconstrained/parallel/orthogonal rank1 and structured/unconstrained rank2 profiling
expected_observation: Most predictable residual headroom lies outside the released Wout output direction
success_signal: Frozen v2 contract passes all orthogonal-headroom and trajectory gates
failure_signal: Orthogonal gain is weak, prompt-unstable, component-regressing, or structured rank2 misses the shared rank2 control
estimated_cost: One smoke plus two full GPU2 profiles
decision_reason: Both checkpoints fail the frozen 80% orthogonal-retention and 90% structured-rank2-retention gates; FP-trajectory AC also regresses 5.49%/7.53%
notes: The data support a large non-parallel residual subspace, not a stable basis defined by the released Wout plus one orthogonal vector; no implementation/calibration/VBench

source_tension: Released MTD fixes every query to the same-centre 3x3 and then averages all spatial-query losses equally, while related work shows token saliency and coarse-to-fine matching are non-uniform
idea: Equal-budget adaptive MTD candidate and importance diagnostic
mechanism: Use teacher feature similarity to test 5x5 top-9 and coarse-centred 3x3 candidates; audit cheap per-query importance proxies against current MTD error
baseline_delta: Diagnostic only; no training-path change and no optical flow
supporting_evidence: Fresh prompts0,2,6 show about 61% teacher mass/top1 outside fixed 3x3; structured centred 3x3 improves both KL and motion in all 18 prompt-phase views; FP/Q-error proxy passes per prompt
closest_prior_work: S2Q-VDiT and QuantSparse are closest; novelty must reside in correspondence localization rather than attention weighting
novelty_risk: High if reduced to attention weights; moderate if position-conditioned candidate construction survives controlled tests
cheapest_falsification: Teacher-only 5x5 search plus equal-budget fixed/top9/centred/random comparisons on paired FP/Q captures
expected_observation: Useful teacher matches leave the fixed 3x3 and at least one cheap proxy identifies high-current-loss positions
success_signal: Frozen adaptive-MTD v1 candidate or importance gate passes on real captures
failure_signal: Wider search stays inside 3x3, random matches adaptive candidates, or all non-oracle proxies fail
estimated_cost: CPU L0/L1 plus fresh three-prompt L2 confirmation
decision_reason: Candidate and importance mechanisms pass the frozen multi-prompt gate; random and arbitrary top9 controls fail to reproduce the joint KL/motion gain
notes: Existing RAFT-guided script and results explicitly excluded; proceed only through a separate controlled calibration contract
